title: Inequality and visibility of wealth in experimental social networks.
central_claims: Visibility of wealth amplifies inequality and reduces cooperative welfare in experimental social networks.

source_manifest.title: Camerer et al. SSRP supplementary methods and Tables 1, 3 and 4
source_manifest.finding: Visibility increased inequality under high initial inequality: r=.116, p=.011, 480 observations/792 participants, using the documented clustering adjustment.
